sloka: अतीव खलु ते कांता वसुधा वसुधाधिप ।गत असुर् अपि ताम् गात्रैः माम् विहाय निषेवसे ॥४-२०-६॥
transliteration: atīva khalu te kāṁtā vasudhā vasudhādhipa ।gata asur api tām gātraiḥ mām vihāya niṣevase ॥4-20-6॥

translations.english: 'O lord of the earth I know you loved the earth more than you loved me since you have forsaken me and enjoy her company by hugging her with your limbs, even after death.
